_meta.description: Grouped Process counting signups by month on training_data.pulse (January 2024 to May 2025) decorated with an OVERLAY_YOY group overlay: each month against the same month a year earlier, current / prior * 100. The 2024 months have no prior year and stay null, with no warning; January to May 2025 each carry an index (January about 84, February about 127). The host GROUP_DATE's params.frequency monthly tells the empty ref.yoy marker how far back a year is. Buffered: the prior-period lookup reads the finished series.
